subject: Call for Collaboration: Interactive Maps in R Tutorial

messages.author: e0691e26c9cf72eb
messages.subject: Call for Collaboration: Interactive Maps in R Tutorial
parts:
Geospatial R folks,

Next quarter for #maptimeDavis we've been thinking about doing a session
on interactive maps with R. Something that extends on things that Ryan
touched on last year, so using the following as a starting point, but
making sure to break it down for newer people, and go into more depth.
https://ryanpeek.github.io/mapping_in_R/maps_mapview.html
https://ryanpeek.github.io/mapping_in_R/maps_leaflet.html

I'm looking for some people to collaborate on this idea with me (results
will probably end up on https://rspatial.org). Send me an email if you'd
like to collaborate on this.

Thanks,
--
Alex Mandel, PhD

Center for Spatial Sciences
https://spatial.ucdavis.edu
Geospatial and Farming Systems Research Consortium
https://gfc.ucdavis.edu
University of California, Davis
